On 09/17/2014 04:22 PM, Fiona Vande Velde wrote:
> Hi there,
>
> Does anyone have some good examples of published articles in the domain
> of social sciences using sem in Lavaan?

A good start is to look to those papers that cite the lavaan (2012)
paper. Google scholar returns about 245 hits, a large portion of which
are published papers. Many of them in the social sciences:

http://scholar.google.be/scholar?cites=3069375885583311800&as_sdt=2005&sciodt=0,5&hl=en

The web of science lists 94 citations.

Yves.
